about: Every BSE/NSE pair the old matcher merged in Sept 2026 whose labels pointed at different kinds of filing (399). Each was checked by hand: same_filing true = both rows are the same disclosure; false = two different filings by the same company joined by mistake; null = could not tell. Used to test merge tightening (merge.clearly_different).
